message: VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "CHK_age" runs in the same transaction that added it NOT VALID, so it gains nothing: the ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock from adding it blocks reads and writes to "users" until the transaction commits, and the validation reads the whole table under that lock.
why: NOT VALID skips the table scan when the constraint is added, and VALIDATE CONSTRAINT checks the rows later under a weaker lock. Locks last until the transaction ends, so the weaker lock only helps once the transaction that added the constraint has committed.
safeAlternative: Validate in a transaction of its own, after the one that added the constraint has committed. With TypeORM, migrationsTransactionMode "all" (the default) runs every pending migration in one transaction, so a VALIDATE in a separate migration only helps when it is deployed in a later release, or with "each".
